functions.name: add-app-dependency
functions.description: Attach an existing Chrome extension app as a web app's default dependency for future runs.

dependencyAppId.description: Existing Chrome extension app UUID in the same organization.

FunctionOutput_autosana_addappdependency.description: The app UUIDs acknowledged by Autosana after attaching the default dependency.

tags.instructions: Find both UUIDs with `list-apps`: the primary app must be web and the dependency chrome-extension in the same organization. This adds a default association, not a new app. Use `remove-app-dependency` to undo it or run-time dependencies to override one run.

functions.name: add-flow-to-suite
functions.description: Attach an existing flow at the end of a suite, preserving the flow and its run history.

flowId.description: UUID of the existing flow to append.

FunctionInput_autosana_addflowtosuite.description: Existing flow and destination suite to associate.

position.description: Zero-based position assigned at the end of the suite.

FunctionOutput_autosana_addflowtosuite.description: Attached flow membership and its assigned position.

tags.instructions: Use existing suite and flow UUIDs from their dashboard records. The flow is appended; this does not remove it from any other suite. Use `remove-flow-from-suite` to detach an association or `move-flow-between-suites` for relocation. A suite's member and authentication flows must have compatible device counts.

functions.name: add-label-to-flow
functions.description: Attach an existing organization label to one saved test flow.

FunctionInput_autosana_addlabeltoflow.description: The existing flow and organization label to associate.

FunctionOutput_autosana_addlabeltoflow.description: Acknowledgment that the label association was created.

tags.instructions: Get the flow UUID from `list-flows` and the label UUID from the label catalog or dashboard. This creates only an association. Use `remove-label-from-flow` to undo it. Running by label uses label names, not these UUIDs.

functions.name: add-label-to-suite
functions.description: Attach one existing organization label to a suite without changing the label or suite identity.

labelId.description: UUID of an existing organization label to attach.

suiteId.description: UUID of the suite to label.

FunctionInput_autosana_addlabeltosuite.description: Existing suite and organization label to associate.

added.description: Autosana acknowledged creation of this suite-label association.

labelId.description: Unchanged UUID of the attached label.

FunctionOutput_autosana_addlabeltosuite.description: Acknowledged suite-label attachment with unchanged input identifiers.

tags.instructions: Get labelId from `list-labels` and a suite UUID from the suite dashboard. This adds one association, not a new label. Use `create-label` first if needed and `remove-label-from-suite` to detach it later. Already attached labels return a conflict.

functions.name: add-member
functions.description: Invite a member or administrator to the company. Existing Autosana users are added immediately; pending invitations are resent.

role.description: Company role to grant; defaults to member.

email.description: Email address to invite; passed without local case normalization.

FunctionInput_autosana_addmember.description: Details of the person to invite and the company role to grant.

id.description: UUID returned for the invited or added member.

FunctionOutput_autosana_addmember.description: Member returned after invitation processing; does not confirm email delivery or acceptance.

tags.instructions: Use for onboarding or resending a pending invitation. The connection's API key acts as an administrator. New users receive setup email; existing users gain access immediately and receive notification email. Repeating can resend invitations. SSO organizations must use their identity provider. Use `list-members` before inviting someone who may already belong.

functions.name: batch-create-flow-runs
functions.description: Start a native batch of up to 100 explicitly identified saved flows and return aggregate execution tracking information.

items.description: Saved flow UUID to start.

flowIds.description: One to 100 distinct saved flow UUIDs to start together.

variables.description: Ordinary string build-variable map attached to the selected build.

appBuildId.description: Optional exact build UUID for all selected flows.

appIdentifier.description: Web application identifier or mobile custom application identifier, not app UUID.

suiteOverrides.description: Map ambiguous selected flow UUIDs to suite UUIDs for auth/variables; ignored when suite context resolution is disabled.

additionalProperties.description: Suite UUID supplying context for the flow named by the map key.

resolveSuiteContext.description: Resolve suite auth/variables for selected individual flows; defaults true.

FunctionInput_autosana_batchcreateflowru.description: Explicit saved flows and application settings for one native execution batch.

status.description: Provider start status, not per-flow completion.

batchUrl.description: Dashboard URL for the entire batch.

inferredRef.description: Build-inferred code ref, included only when reported.

flowRunCount.description: Provider-created flow-run count, which may include auth runs.

items.description: Provider-created run-group UUID.

flowGroupRunIds.description: Provider-created run-group UUIDs; not correlated per-input outcomes.

FunctionOutput_autosana_batchcreateflowr.description: Aggregate batch-start acknowledgment and dashboard tracking, not completed execution results.

tags.instructions: Use `list-flows` for flow UUIDs and `list-apps` for the application's identifier. Use `create-flow-run` for one flow or `create-run-batch` for suite/label/folder selection and advanced execution settings. This starts background execution, not completed results. Maximum 100 flow IDs; do not replay an uncertain start because tests may execute twice.

functions.name: cancel-run-group
functions.description: Terminate an entire flow run group using either the group UUID or any individual child run UUID.

runId.description: UUID of a group or any individual child run; either choice targets the whole parent group.

FunctionInput_autosana_cancelrungroup.description: Identify the entire run group to terminate using its group UUID or a child run UUID.

runId.description: Group or child UUID originally supplied.

runGroupId.description: Resolved parent group UUID actually targeted.

status.description: Current group status after acknowledgment; may still be terminating.

action.description: Immediate termination, pending worker termination, or no action because already terminal.

FunctionOutput_autosana_cancelrungroup.description: Provider acknowledgment of termination for the resolved parent run group, without waiting for completion.

tags.instructions: Use a group UUID from the test-start response or an individual run UUID from `get-run-batch` or `get-run`. A child UUID stops its entire parent group, including sibling flows. The result may be terminating rather than finished. Keep the original batch UUID and use `get-run-batch` to check progress, or `get-run` for a child. Already-terminal groups produce no action.

functions.name: create-build-upload
functions.description: Prepare a mobile or extension build upload and return the short-lived URL for transferring the original file.

name.description: Optional app display name; can rename an existing app.

bundleId.description: Mobile bundle identifier or extension bundle identifier.

filename.description: Original build filename: Android APK, iOS simulator ZIP or device IPA, or extension ZIP.

platform.description: Build platform; extensions must be Manifest V3 ZIP archives.

environment.description: Existing mobile environment name; omitted uses the default. Not accepted for extensions.

appIdentifier.description: Mobile custom application identifier; omitted or equal to bundleId selects the bundle-ID app. Other values are at most 64 lowercase letters/numbers with single dot, hyphen or underscore separators and alphanumeric ends.

FunctionInput_autosana_createbuildupload.description: App identity and original filename for preparing a build upload without transferring the file.

uploadUrl.description: Presigned PUT URL valid for one hour; treat as sensitive. Upload original bytes using application/octet-stream without an Autosana API key.

bundleId.description: Bundle identifier used when preparing the upload.

filePath.description: Opaque provider storage path for the pending upload.

platform.description: Platform used when preparing the upload.

environment.description: Explicit environment name if one was supplied; omission retains default-environment selection.

appIdentifier.description: Custom mobile app identifier if one was supplied.

uploadContext.description: Identity and storage context to pass unchanged to finalize-build-upload after transferring bytes.

FunctionOutput_autosana_createbuilduploa.description: Short-lived binary upload URL and unchanged identity context for subsequent build finalization.

tags.instructions: Use this when your CI client already has the build file. PUT the original bytes to uploadUrl as application/octet-stream within one hour, then call `create-build-from-upload` with the returned upload context. This does not transfer the file or finalize a build. It can create an app or change its display name.

functions.name: create-flow-run
functions.description: Start one saved test flow against a web or mobile app and return a batch tracking link without waiting for test completion.

suiteId.description: Suite UUID to use for this flow's ambiguous auth/variable context; ignored when resolveSuiteContext=false.

bundleId.description: Mobile bundle identifier, required with platform.

variables.description: Build variables to attach and inject as ordinary strings; omitted sends no variable override.

additionalProperties.description: An ordinary build variable string, preserved without delimiter parsing.

appBuildId.description: Optional exact build UUID; a branch build may infer flow definitions at its commit.

appIdentifier.description: Web application identifier or optional mobile custom application identifier, not app UUID.

resolveSuiteContext.description: Resolve suite auth/variables before this flow, default true; false runs without suite context.

FunctionInput_autosana_createflowrun.description: Start one saved flow against a web application or a mobile bundle and platform.

status.description: Execution-start status, not a final test outcome.

inferredRef.description: Build-inferred code ref when returned; omitted otherwise.

flowRunCount.description: Provider-reported created flow-run count; do not assume one because auth can be included.

items.description: One provider-created run-group UUID.

FunctionOutput_autosana_createflowrun.description: Acknowledgment and tracking information for the started batch, without waiting for completion.

tags.instructions: Find a flow UUID with `list-flows` and the application's identifier with `list-apps`. Use `create-run-batch` for multiple flows, suites, labels/folders, code refs, extension overrides, or custom browser/device settings. Suite auth is resolved by default; use suiteId to disambiguate membership or resolveSuiteContext=false to skip auth. Starting can modify the tested app; do not blindly replay.

functions.name: create-hook
functions.description: Create a named runtime, setup, or teardown hook script. Creation does not attach the hook or execute it.

scriptType.description: Interpreter or launch-argument format of the script.

description.description: Optional human-readable note; omission leaves it unspecified.

FunctionInput_autosana_createhook.description: Named hook script to save without executing or attaching it.

name.description: Saved immutable hook name.

createdAt.description: Creation instant normalized to UTC, preserving fractional precision.

description.description: Saved note; omitted when not returned and null when explicitly unset.

FunctionOutput_autosana_createhook.description: Saved hook script with its creation instant normalized to UTC.

tags.instructions: Use this to save a new script. Runtime instructions can reference it as `${hooks:NAME}`. Use `create-hook-execution` to execute it and `update-hook` to change an existing script. Setup and teardown attachment is managed in the dashboard. Hook names cannot later be changed.

functions.name: create-hook-execution
functions.description: Execute a saved hook or unsaved source override against an environment and return captured output and execution outcome.

hookId.description: UUID of the saved hook whose format and source are used.

environmentId.description: UUID of an environment in the same organization whose variables are injected.

scriptOverride.description: Optional ordinary source text to execute instead of the saved source; not persisted. Empty string is sent literally; omission uses saved source.

FunctionInput_autosana_createhookexecuti.description: Saved hook and environment to execute, with an optional unsaved source override.

error.description: Provider failure category when unsuccessful, such as Execution timed out or Missing environment variable; null when absent.

output.description: Captured stdout and stderr as ordinary text.

success.description: Whether execution succeeded; false remains a normal test result.

statusCode.description: Script exit code or curl HTTP status; null when unavailable.

FunctionOutput_autosana_createhookexecut.description: Captured hook output and execution outcome, including unsuccessful executions.

tags.instructions: Obtain hookId from `list-hooks` or `get-hook` and an environment UUID from the environment settings. Use scriptOverride to test a change without saving; use `update-hook` to persist it. This actually executes code and can change external systems; it is not a side-effect-free dry run. Execution has a 60-second limit.

functions.name: create-run-batch
functions.description: Start asynchronous execution of selected flows or suites, including selections by labels or folders, and return the batch tracking information.

ref.description: Branch name or full commit SHA for code-managed definitions and build resolution; requires repoFullName.

device.description: Mobile device selection; omitted uses recommended default. Cannot be combined with devices.

model.description: Supported model or latest; omitted rolls to provider resolution.

physical.description: True for real hardware, false for virtual devices; default false.

osVersion.description: Supported OS version string or latest; omitted rolls to provider resolution.

labels.description: Label-name selectors; union of labeled suites and flows, not label UUIDs.

devices.description: Exactly two mobile targets in Device 1/2 order. Both must be physical or both virtual; one-device flows use the first.

model.description: Supported model or latest; omitted rolls to provider resolution.

physical.description: True for real hardware, false for virtual devices; default false.

osVersion.description: Supported OS version string or latest; omitted rolls to provider resolution.

items.description: Mobile execution target with optional model and OS version selections.

bundleId.description: Mobile bundle identifier; requires platform. Omitted for web.

location.description: ISO country code for web or Android virtual-device traffic; not iOS or real-device runs.

platform.description: Mobile platform; requires bundleId. Omitted for web.

suiteIds.description: Suite UUID selectors; each selected suite runs its flows.

folderIds.description: Folder UUID selectors; recursively includes contained suites and standalone flows.

variables.description: Build variables attached to the selected build and injected through ${env:KEY}; ordinary string values.

appBuildId.description: Optional build UUID belonging to the resolved app; otherwise active/ref-selected build is used.

webBrowser.description: Web browser choice, default chrome; ignored for mobile. Loaded extensions force Chromium and reject firefox.

folderPaths.description: Paths below .autosana/ at ref; exclusive of other selector forms, suiteOverrides and resolveSuiteContext.

dependencies.description: Web extension override; omitted inherits defaults, [] disables extensions for this run.

appId.description: Extension app UUID in the same organization.

appBuildId.description: Optional exact build UUID for this extension; omitted uses its active build.

items.description: Extension application and optional exact build selection.

repoFullName.description: Connected repository owner/repo, required with ref.

appIdentifier.description: Web application identifier; for mobile, optional custom application identifier rather than app UUID.

suiteOverrides.description: Map ambiguous flow UUIDs to suite UUIDs whose auth/variables should apply; ignored when resolveSuiteContext=false.

parallelizeFlows.description: Explicit suite parallelism override; omitted or null uses each saved setting.

resolveSuiteContext.description: Default true for individual flows; false skips suite auth and suite-scoped variables. Omit for folderPaths.

FunctionInput_autosana_createrunbatch.description: Select tests and configure one asynchronous Autosana run batch.

name.description: Provider's batch name when supplied, typically for folder selections; omitted otherwise.

status.description: Provider execution-start status, not a passed/failed test result.

batchId.description: Opaque batch UUID for subsequent tracking.

batchUrl.description: Dashboard URL for the entire batch.

inferredRef.description: Build-derived code ref when Autosana reports inferred commit execution; omitted otherwise.

flowRunCount.description: Provider-reported number of flow runs created.

flowGroupRunIds.description: Created run-group UUIDs, not fabricated per-selector successes.

FunctionOutput_autosana_createrunbatch.description: Aggregate start acknowledgment and tracking information, not completed test results.

tags.instructions: Use `list-flows`, `list-apps`, `list-app-builds`, and `list-devices` to discover targets. For just one saved flow use `create-flow-run`. This starts tests and can modify the app under test and build variables; it does not wait for completion. Use batchUrl to inspect results. Labels are names; flow/suite/folder/build references are UUIDs. At most 100 explicit selectors per call; selected suites/folders may expand to more flows. Do not blindly retry an uncertain start.

functions.name: create-suite
functions.description: Create a test suite with optional descriptive context and authentication instructions that run before each flow.

name.description: Name for the new suite, from 1 to 255 characters.

description.description: Optional description of what the suite tests; omission leaves it unset.

branchName.description: Optional Git branch name shown for build identification.

Omit environment to use the workspace default, or supply an existing environment name. Registration always creates a new build and may update the app name and start automations or GitHub checks. Supply repository metadata when using GitHub integration. The result acknowledges registration, not test completion; do not replay an unclear result without checking the dashboard.

flowId.description: Opaque identifier of the executed flow, or null if unavailable.

status.description: Provider run status, such as passed, failed or error; null if unavailable. Other provider statuses are preserved.

flowName.description: Name of the executed flow, or null if unavailable.

createdAt.description: Run creation instant in UTC Z, retaining fractional precision; determines range membership.

startedAt.description: Execution start instant in UTC Z without precision loss, or null if not started.

actionCount.description: Total AI actions taken by the run, equal to cached plus uncached counts.

completedAt.description: Completion instant in UTC Z without precision loss, or null if not completed.

durationSeconds.description: Elapsed seconds from execution start to completion, retaining fractions; null until finished or if never started.

uncachedActionCount.description: AI actions not replayed from cache.

items.description: A flow run and its provider-reported lifecycle and AI action usage.
One provider page of runs, oldest first by run creation.

nextCursor.description: Opaque continuation token for the same connection and range, omitted when has_more is false.

FunctionOutput_autosana_listrunusage.description: One oldest-first page of run usage and an optional continuation cursor.

tags.instructions: Use this to inspect runs behind `get-usage-totals`. Supply an explicit-offset start and end, with end after start. Each call returns one page, default 100 and maximum 500 runs. Pass nextCursor back as cursor with the same range and connection to continue. A run's actions are attributed to its creation range, not the time each action occurred.

functions.name: list-suites
functions.description: List all test suites in the connected organization with their context and authentication configuration.

FunctionInput_autosana_listsuites.description: No input parameters are needed to list organization suites.

count.description: Provider-reported total number of suites returned in this response.

name.description: Stored suite name.

createdAt.description: Creation instant normalized to UTC Z without losing fractional precision.

createdBy.description: Creating user, null for older suites; omitted if absent upstream.

id.description: Opaque identifier of the creating user.

name.description: Display name of the creating user.

description.description: Suite description, null when unset; omitted if absent upstream.

setupFlowId.description: Opaque UUID of the authentication setup flow, null when none exists; omitted if absent upstream.

instructions.description: Suite-level AI context, null when unset; omitted if absent upstream.

authInstructions.description: Authentication steps before each flow, null when unconfigured; omitted if absent upstream.

items.description: A test suite with its context and authentication configuration.
All suites returned for the organization in the provider's unspecified order.

FunctionOutput_autosana_listsuites.description: The complete organization suite collection and its provider-reported count.

tags.instructions: Use this to discover suite IDs or browse suite configuration. Use `get-suite` for one known ID. The provider returns this collection in a single response; there is no continuation cursor. This does not list the flows inside each suite.

functions.name: move-flow-between-suites
functions.description: Attach a flow to a destination suite and remove its source-suite membership while preserving its identity and run history.

flowId.description: UUID of the existing flow to relocate.

sourceSuiteId.description: UUID of the suite membership to remove.

destinationSuiteId.description: UUID of a different suite to receive the flow at its end.

FunctionInput_autosana_moveflowbetweensu.description: Existing flow and distinct source and destination suite identities for the move.

outcome.description: moved means both writes were acknowledged; the other value means destination attachment succeeded but source removal was not established.

destinationSuiteId.description: Destination suite whose attachment was acknowledged.

sourceRemovalError.description: Present only when source removal was not established; explains recovery without claiming rollback.

code.description: Failure category for the source-detachment stage.

message.description: Provider detail or interpretation explaining why removal could not be established; inspect source membership before retrying.

destinationPosition.description: Zero-based destination append position returned by Autosana.

FunctionOutput_autosana_moveflowbetweens.description: Acknowledged destination attachment and the established or unresolved source-removal outcome.

tags.instructions: Use a flow UUID and distinct source and destination suite UUIDs. The move appends to the destination and removes only the specified source association. It uses two writes and is not atomic; a partial result means the flow is attached to the destination but may still belong to the source. Use `add-flow-to-suite` if both memberships should remain.

functions.name: remove-app-dependency
functions.description: Detach a default Chrome extension association from a web app for future runs without deleting either app.

appId.description: Web app UUID whose default dependency will be removed.

FunctionInput_autosana_removeappdependen.description: The web app and its default Chrome extension association to detach.

detached.description: Provider-reported detach result; not a statement that either app was deleted.

FunctionOutput_autosana_removeappdepende.description: The association identifiers and the detach result reported by Autosana.

tags.instructions: Obtain UUIDs using `list-apps` or `list-app-dependencies`. Historical runs retain their exact extension builds. The association can be added again with `add-app-dependency`; this does not delete extension content.

functions.name: remove-flow-from-suite
functions.description: Detach an existing flow from a suite without deleting the flow or its run history.

flowId.description: UUID of the member flow to detach, without deleting it.

suiteId.description: UUID of the suite whose association is removed.

FunctionInput_autosana_removeflowfromsui.description: The suite and member flow whose association will be removed.

flowId.description: Unchanged UUID of the detached flow.

removed.description: Autosana acknowledged detachment of this association.

suiteId.description: Suite UUID from which membership was removed.

FunctionOutput_autosana_removeflowfromsu.description: Acknowledgment that the specified suite-flow association was removed.

tags.instructions: Use known suite and flow UUIDs. This removes only that membership; the flow remains available. Use `add-flow-to-suite` to attach it elsewhere or `move-flow-between-suites` for a two-suite relocation. No flow deletion occurs.

functions.name: remove-label-from-flow
functions.description: Detach one label from a flow without deleting the flow or label.

flowId.description: Flow UUID whose association is removed.

labelId.description: Attached label UUID, not the label name.

FunctionInput_autosana_removelabelfromfl.description: Identify the flow and its attached label to detach.

flowId.description: Flow UUID whose label association was removed.

removed.description: Provider acknowledged association removal, not resource deletion.

FunctionOutput_autosana_removelabelfromf.description: Acknowledgment of removing one flow-label association.

tags.instructions: Use the existing flow and label UUIDs from their catalogs or dashboard. This removes only their association and can change which tests match a label-based run. Use `add-label-to-flow` to reattach it.

functions.name: remove-label-from-suite
functions.description: Remove one suite-label association without deleting the label, suite, or other label associations.

labelId.description: UUID of the attached label; the label itself is retained.

suiteId.description: UUID of the suite whose label association is removed.

labelId.description: Unchanged UUID of the retained label.

removed.description: Autosana acknowledged removal of this association only.

suiteId.description: Suite UUID from which the label was detached.

FunctionOutput_autosana_removelabelfroms.description: Acknowledgment that the specified suite-label association was removed.

tags.instructions: Use labelId from `list-labels` and the suite UUID. This changes only that suite's membership. Use `delete-label` only when the label and every association should be removed organization-wide. A detached label can later be added again with `add-label-to-suite`.

functions.name: remove-member
functions.description: Remove a member's company membership and access to all company workspaces. Owners and admins must be removed in the dashboard.

memberId.description: UUID of the company member whose membership should be removed.

removed.description: Autosana acknowledged removal from the company and its workspaces.

memberId.description: UUID whose company membership was removed.

FunctionOutput_autosana_removemember.description: Acknowledgment that the company membership was removed.

tags.instructions: Get memberId and role from `list-members`. This revokes company-wide workspace access, not just access to one workspace, and does not claim to delete the person's Autosana account. Owners and admins require Settings → Team. Reinviting later is a separate task via `add-member`.

functions.name: update-environment-variable
functions.description: Partially update a variable, rotate a secret, or explicitly switch between plaintext and secret storage.

key.description: New variable name; references to the old name are not rewritten.

value.description: New ordinary string value; omitted or null keeps the value. Empty strings are not accepted. A real storage transition requires a non-null value.

isSecret.description: Desired encrypted/write-only state; an actual change requires a new value.

description.description: New note; omitted leaves it unchanged, null or empty string explicitly clears it.

FunctionInput_autosana_updateenvironment.description: Identify an environment variable and supply at least one field to partially update.

value.description: Current returned plaintext/null or *** for a secret; never decrypted content.

createdAt.description: Original creation instant in UTC Z preserving precision.

updatedAt.description: Last actual state-change instant in UTC Z; a no-op does not advance it.

description.description: Stored note or cleared representation returned by the provider.

FunctionOutput_autosana_updateenvironmen.description: The updated environment variable with masked secrets and precision-preserving UTC timestamps.

tags.instructions: Find the UUID with `list-environments` or inspect it with `get-environment-variable`. Omitted fields stay unchanged. A storage-type transition requires a new value. Renaming does not rewrite ${env:OLD_KEY} references: update affected flows and hooks yourself. Values cannot be cleared; delete the variable instead.

functions.name: update-flow
functions.description: Partially update a saved flow's name, instructions, or device count without changing omitted fields.

name.description: New display name; omitted preserves it.

deviceCount.description: New required device count; omitted preserves it.

instructions.description: Replacement natural-language instructions; omitted preserves them. Empty explicitly replaces with empty instructions.

FunctionInput_autosana_updateflow.description: A saved flow UUID and only the fields to replace.

name.description: Current display name.

createdAt.description: Original creation instant in UTC Z with precision preserved.

name.description: Creator display name.

cachingMode.description: Unchanged flow cache mode; null inherits workspace mode.

FunctionOutput_autosana_updateflow.description: The updated saved flow definition with its original creation details.

tags.instructions: Obtain a flow UUID with `list-flows` or `get-flow`. Supply only changes. Device-count changes must remain consistent with every suite member/auth flow. This does not run tests, move suite membership, or change cache mode.

functions.name: update-hook
functions.description: Partially update a hook's source, script type, or description without changing its name.

hookId.description: UUID of the hook to modify.

script.description: Replacement source text; an empty string is sent literally, omission preserves source.

scriptType.description: New script format; omission preserves the saved format.

description.description: New note; null or empty string clears it, omission preserves it.

FunctionInput_autosana_updatehook.description: A hook UUID and at least one partial update, without changing its name.

id.description: UUID of the hook whose update was acknowledged.

updated.description: Autosana acknowledged the partial update; does not indicate script execution.

FunctionOutput_autosana_updatehook.description: Acknowledgment of the saved hook update, not the current hook record.

tags.instructions: Obtain hookId from `list-hooks` or `get-hook`. Only supplied fields change; null or empty description clears it. Names cannot be changed. Use `create-hook-execution` with an override before saving experimental source. This saves but does not execute the script.

functions.name: update-label
functions.description: Partially update a label's name or display color. Renaming changes the name used by CI and runs-by-label.

name.description: Replacement label name; omission preserves the current name.

color.description: Replacement six-digit hexadecimal color; omission preserves the current color.

labelId.description: UUID of the label to modify.

FunctionInput_autosana_updatelabel.description: Label identifier and the name or display color fields to change.

name.description: Saved name after the update.

color.description: Saved display color after the update.

createdAt.description: Original creation instant in UTC Z with precision retained.

FunctionOutput_autosana_updatelabel.description: The saved label, its original creation instant, and active membership counts.

functions.name: update-suite
functions.description: Partially update a suite's name, description, AI context or authentication steps. Removing authentication entirely requires the Autosana dashboard.

suiteId.description: UUID of the existing suite in the connected organization.

name.description: Replacement suite name; omission preserves the current name.

description.description: Replacement description; null clears it, an empty string is sent as text, and omission preserves it.

instructions.description: Replacement non-executable suite context; null clears it, an empty string is sent as text, and omission preserves it.

authInstructions.description: Replacement login steps executed before each flow. Omission preserves them; null and empty text are not supported removal mechanisms. Use ${env:VAR_NAME} for credentials.

FunctionInput_autosana_updatesuite.description: An existing suite ID and at least one field to change; omitted fields remain unchanged.

id.description: Opaque UUID of the updated suite.

name.description: Stored suite name after the update.

createdAt.description: Original suite creation instant in UTC Z, preserving fractional precision; not an update time.

createdBy.description: Original creating user, null for older suites; omitted if absent upstream.

id.description: Opaque identifier of the creating user.

name.description: Display name of the creating user.

description.description: Stored description, null when cleared or unset; omitted if absent upstream.

setupFlowId.description: Opaque UUID of the authentication setup flow, null when none exists; omitted if absent upstream.

instructions.description: Stored suite context, null when cleared or unset; omitted if absent upstream.

authInstructions.description: Stored authentication steps, null when unconfigured; omitted if absent upstream.

FunctionOutput_autosana_updatesuite.description: The resulting suite returned by Autosana, with its original creation instant normalized to UTC.

tags.instructions: Obtain a suite ID from `list-suites` or `create-suite`. Use `get-suite` if you need its current configuration first. Supply only fields to change; null clears description or context. Authentication steps can be replaced, not removed here. Use the dashboard to remove authentication. Existing content may be overwritten.
